text:
ada: quick little brag train 389 we shipped 1.0 GA today and crossed 12,000,000 monthly inference requests in the same deploy. surreal.
yuri: WHAT A DAY. congrats team!! :tada: :rocket:
samir: massive well done. quick question — any postmortem smoke? all green on my end.
ada: zero regressions flagged, P95 improved slightly thanks to autotune. ops nailed the rollout.
deploy-bot: deployment 2026.03.25-7 completed to production by @yuri. health checks: passed.
yuri: can we have a tiny in-office celebration at 4pm? cake + a short "ship horn" moment?
samir: yes to cake. and stickers. many stickers.
swag-bot: swag poll created: "Stickers or Hoodies?"  stickers: 4 votes, hoodies: 1 vote. Poll closes in 4h.
comm-team: drafting announcement for #announcements: "Redwood Inference v1.0 GA + 12M monthly inferences. Thank you to every team member who shipped, tested, and supported the rollout." feedback?
ada: add a line thanking customers and linking the dashboard snapshot. also call out the optimize recommendations that reduced unit costs.
yuri: good call. i'll ping comms a screenshot.
samir: snacks at 4 sounds good. i'll bring a tiny bluetooth speaker for victory bops.
yuri: GIF drop time: https://giphy.com/gifs/celebrate-xyz789
ada: small ask: remote folks want a livestream for the toast at 4:05. can someone set up Zoom?
comm-team: will do. tagging @oliver from infra for the stream setup.
samir: mini-game: best ship pun wins a sticker pack. i'll start: "Ship happens."
yuri: oh no, that's peak dad energy. adding mine: "We came, we saw, we inference-d."
ada: also planning a tiny plaque for the kitchen: "First GA launch — 2026-03-25." who wants to sign it?
comm-team: we'll bring a Sharpie. everyone sign!
swag-bot: reaction :tada: added by ada
yuri: remote shoutout to ops who stayed late last night. you folks are legends.
samir: also — deploy metrics looked stable under load. proud of the chaos we managed.
ada: short cadence: photos at 4:10, quick toast at 4:05, stickers handed out after the cake.
comm-team: scheduled announcement post at 17:00 and a tweet draft for socials.
yuri: tiny brag: my houseplant finally survived my neglect and is celebrating too. coincidence? maybe not.
samir: next target: 20M monthly inferences. tonight: cake and stickers. tomorrow: incremental batching tweaks.
ada: love this. see you all at 4pm, in person or via stream 49b
swag-bot: scheduled reminder for #random at 15:50: "v1.0 GA celebration + stickers at 4pm"
yuri: thank you team. couldn't have shipped without every midnight deploy hero and ticket closer. onward and upward :rocket:
